fields.description:
Discovered while implementing e9d5-c850-d505-4a5a (typed reconciler mutation payload contracts, ADR 0107). ADR 0107 is canonical: outbound/update payloads use OutboundUpdatePayload and its wrapped legacy projection, not the older flat differ.py update payload.

Resolved design:
- Canonical outbound/update payload shape is wrapped: {"changed_fields": {...}, "comments": [...], "labels": [...], "links": [...], "local_id": ... when present}.
- outbound_pass.py already constructs OutboundUpdatePayload and is the precedent.
- differ.py's older _compute_mutations_emit_both path must migrate from payload=changed to the wrapped ADR 0107 OutboundUpdatePayload shape.
- Do not invent a third shape or compatibility bypass.

Worked example: for an outbound update that changes summary from "old" to "new", the Mutation payload must contain {"changed_fields": {"summary": "new"}, "comments": [], "labels": [], "links": []}; it must not be {"summary": "new"}.

Surface parity census:
- CLI command: out of scope; this is reconciler internals, proven through unit/contract tests rather than a CLI command.
- MCP/API/library facade: out of scope; no public facade constructs this payload directly.
- Automated callers: in scope; tests must exercise the differ.py producer used by reconciler automation and compare it to outbound_pass.py/OutboundUpdatePayload serialization.
- Dual direction: in scope by contrast; inbound/create remains flat per ADR 0107 and must not be changed by this ticket.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] differ.py's outbound/update emission uses the ADR 0107 wrapped OutboundUpdatePayload legacy shape with changed_fields/comments/labels/links keys, proven by a contract test that fails against the current flat payload.
- [x] differ.py and outbound_pass.py/OutboundUpdatePayload agree on the observable outbound/update payload shape for an equivalent field update, including empty comments/labels/links collections.
- [x] Inbound/create flat payload behavior is unchanged by this outbound/update migration, proven by an existing or new contrast assertion.

## Testing / Verification
- Add or strengthen tests under tests/ to assert the ADR 0107 outbound/update wrapped shape end-to-end for differ.py and the typed OutboundUpdatePayload producer.
- Run the targeted pytest node(s) covering the new contract and contrast tests.
- Before pushing, run env -u GIT_CONFIG_COUNT -u GIT_CONFIG_KEY_0 -u GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_0 -u GIT_CONFIG_KEY_1 -u GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_1 -u GIT_CONFIG_KEY_2 -u GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_2 PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" make verify.
